offset_definition: pcap walltime microseconds minus relative monotonic send microseconds, centered by median all10000offsets; no absolute monotonic-to-wall anchor exists
limitations: No RTT correction or missing-slot exclusion
PCAP forward span includes router queue, forward path, server echo handling and pre-server-ingress scheduling
PCAP-to-send residual combines syscall/ingress timestamp delay and wall/monotonic clock mapping; negative centered values are not negative physical delays
No sender process CPU/affinity trace, sender cgroup resources, vCPU scheduler or clockevent telemetry in this collection
Largest sender lag is accumulated backlog and not one pause duration
Cause remains unidentified; observations do not prove VM clock failure or CPU scheduler cause
